name: Tomorrow
overview: Scripture teaches believers to avoid boasting about or worrying over tomorrow, recognizing that the future is uncertain and ultimately in God's hands, as Proverbs 27:1 warns against presuming on the next day. Jesus instructs us to trust God for our daily needs without anxiety, emphasizing that each day has enough trouble of its own (Matthew 6:25, 34). Instead of being consumed with future concerns, believers are called to seek first God's kingdom and righteousness, trusting that all necessary things will be provided (Matthew 6:33). Prayerful dependence on God, rather than anxious planning, is encouraged (Philippians 4:6), and James 4:13 cautions against confident assertions about future plans, reminding us that life is ultimately subject to God's sovereign will.
